requirements.statement: Recursively flatten nested arrays, retaining leaf values, duplicates and left-to-right order.
requirements.expected_behavior: Recursively flatten nested arrays, retaining leaf values, duplicates and left-to-right order.
requirements.input_domain: Dense finite JSON arrays with nested arrays, objects as leaves, scalars and null; depth at most four in these examples.
assumptions: Retrospective public task; expectations prepared by Codex from cited sources, not separately human-reviewed.
Exact finite JSON values in the declared domain; no universal correctness claim.

provenance.excerpt: > Recursively flatten an array or arrays. This is the fastest implementation of array flatten.
provenance.justification: The README recursive flattening contract and ordered example justify depth-first left-to-right traversal. Objects and JSON scalars are leaves, empty arrays contribute no leaves, and duplicate elements are retained. No uniqueness or sorting behavior is specified.
